item.title: Retrain Your Brain's Reward System
item.description: Feeling drained by endless scrolling and quick hits of pleasure? Here's how to reset your brain's reward system with a lesson from the ICU.

item.title: It's the Relationship That Matters Most in Therapy
item.description: Therapy's true power isn't in the latest buzzwords or brands; it's in the relationship between client and therapist.

item.title: Hallucinations Happen When the Brain Fills in the Blanks
item.description: Psychedelics and Parkinson’s may trigger hallucinations through the same system, revealing how fragile the balance is between externally and internally generated perception.

item.title: Connect to Your Dark Side to Heal
item.description: Anxiety, anger, envy, and schadenfreude are products of your body in response to perceptions of threat. Suppressing them begets repetitive unwanted thoughts. Train your brain to be less reactive and heal.

item.title: Helping Your Child Develop a Positive Academic Self-Concept
item.description: Just about the only thing we measure school success by is grades. However, I want you to pay attention to a lot more than the report card.

item.title: Covid raises risk of heart issues in children more than vaccination
item.description: Getting covid-19 for the first time slightly increased the risk of heart inflammation, blood clots and bleeding disorders among children, whereas being vaccinated against the virus was much safer and sometimes protective
